description: Class representing a theme color scheme.

ChangeColor.description: Changes a color in the theme color scheme.

params.description: Color position in the color scheme which will be changed.
params.name: nPos

params.description: New color of the theme color scheme.
params.name: oColor

ChangeColor.signature: ChangeColor(nPos: number, oColor: ApiColor | ApiUniColor | ApiRGBColor): boolean

Copy.description: Creates a copy of the current theme color scheme.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiThemeColorScheme class.

GetColor.description: Returns a color of the theme color scheme.

params.description: The color position in the color scheme, the same as in the ChangeColor method:0-5 - accent1-accent6, 6 - dk1, 7 - dk2, 8 - folHlink, 9 - hlink, 10 - lt1, 11 - lt2.
params.name: position

returns.description: The RGB color, or null if the position is out of range or the scheme has no color at this position.

GetSchemeName.description: Returns the name of the current theme color scheme.

SetSchemeName.description: Sets a name to the current theme color scheme.

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiThemeColorScheme object into the JSON object.
